reviews.t: Excellent value for First Class Product!!!
reviews.x: Wow!  What a fabulous product and value for the money. The features are great and the timing device works excellent.  It is so nice and lightweight and compact, too.  I found it extremely easy to use even the first time I used it.  It's worth much more than the market price especially compared to other units.  I would highly recommend it to those looking for quality and value!  I told my husband, Steve, that I would never have to get my nails done by anyone else again.

reviews.t: Barely worked first time, didn’t work the second time
reviews.x: Got the lamp, loved EVERYTHING about it... at first. Loved how thin, sleek, light, and that the screen was built showing within the in it and now protruding in any way BUT then when I go to use it for the first time, I notice that I had to move the wire into a certain position for it to come on which I was willing to overlook because I loved everything else up until I go to use it for a 2nd time and now I can’t even get it to stay on when I do wiggle the wire and find a spot for it to turn on be

reviews.t: Almost perfect but sides need to lock in place...
reviews.x: I like this lamp. The design really helps when I am doing dual forms with polygel. It is really easy for me to get both hands underneath to hold the form. No more air bubbles! 👍🏻. I like that the sides fold down. The reason I gave 4 stars is that there is a minor but annoying design flaw. The sides don’t lock when they are in the open position so they want to collapse. Once stable this works great but it would be 5-star perfect if the sides locked.

reviews.t: COMPACT AND EASY TO TAKE ALONGI
reviews.x: This is the perfect gel curing LED lamp.  It is easy to pack and take with you, lightweight, compact and a great addition to your beauty needs.  I will be using this lamp for a long time to come.  The price was very reasonable and the value was great!

reviews.t: Great device for the price. No disappointments:)
reviews.x: Loved the size , light weight & an incredible device. I’d recommend to to dry first layer of polish, then apply your second. I’m so impressed that I will definitely order some for gift giving. I had zero problems, thank you!
I absolutely love this gel lamp it doesn't take up to much space on my desk it's great purchase!!

I love the portability of this lamp. I used it of my 4 year old daughter and she liked that it didn't make her nails hot like my other one does. Had to run it a couple times until completely dry but waaaay better than the old fashion blowing in nails or sitting in front of a cold fan.
The delivery was very fast. It’s very lightweight and so far it’s working well. Customer service was able to help me with activating my warranty. Overall, I’ve very happy.
Quickly dries my UV only nail polish! Love it! Three price is also great.  It folds down nicely to put in a drawer.
Not strong enough to dry gel ,very disappointed.

First I want to disclose that I was reimbursed for this purchase in return for my review. The first thing I noticed was that the unit was very slim and lightweight.  It came with a USB micro connector and adapter.  After plugging it in,  I noticed the timer. It can be set for 30 seconds or 60 seconds.  The gel products that I used required 90 seconds and 120 seconds respectively,  but it is easy to just hit the button again to add more time. The unit is highly portable and could easily be taken

reviews.t: Lightweight portable but comes with flaws
reviews.x: Only used it for a day and it works okay. I don't have experience using other uv lamps so i can't do a comparison. The gel top coat doesn't seem to solidify completely after trying to cure it for 60s followed by another 60s (it is dry to the touch though) and I did 2 thin coats and cured them separately. I got dents on my nails after poking them using moderate force... Used the lamp again but it won't harden any further.  I used a bright orange red regular nail polish after the base coat and let

I bought this light in January and was happy with it's larger design, which still being "compact." I've used it every other week or so since, and here I am in April, and it has already died. The connection for the power cord into the light itself completely separated from the electronics board making it completely inoperable, and unfixable. For %15 I suppose I get what I pay for, but it's still rather disappointing that this light failed within such a short period of time.

reviews.t: Saves me time and best of all money.
reviews.x: Very light weight and compact. Well worth the money spent. User friendly. Received lamp packaged well and secure with simple and easy to follow instructions. As another reviewer had stated it would be nice for legs to snap in place but this doesn't affect the quality of the product. I would highly recommend this product to others and look forward to an extended period of use saving me lots of time and money.

The led gel setting lamp is small, lightweight, would travel well, and works great too! The base coat gel I have takes about 4 minutes to set but the top coat takes only 90 seconds, which is more of an issue with the gel polish than the light. It does take a little longer than I anticipated to cure but the value for money here is top notch! Highly recommend.

Works perfectly with my gel polish. I had another lamp that was so much more expensive than this one and it died on me after a year.. This one has an amazing price and works even better than my last!  UPDATE: stopped working after six months. I also left a review because I was told they would send me a second one for free and I never received it.

[[VIDEOID:ba80a4568aca4dade24f17b31c72863c]] This is the best gel light I’ve ever used. The compact design is perfect because I don’t have a lot of space at home and it fits perfectly in my nail polish case. It fits both my hand and foot allowing me to set my gel and enjoy a chip free manicure. 10/10 would recommend to a friend.

[[VIDEOID:df9e89238025c5fdcc07616b1bb6a35d]] I like this nail dryer. It is very compact, light weight and uses a USB to run. It comfortably fits both of my feet and hands. The only thing is I have to hit the timer twice sometimes. My young daughter loves to use this on her nails also. For the price you can't beat this.

Great little UV LED lamp. Very light weight, legs fold in and makes it very compact. Has an auto timer for 30 seconds when you push the button and shuts off automatically once the countdown is completed. Comes with a micro USB cord and wall plug.  Worked well with a gel polish that requires a UV LED light to cure.

I like the lamp it's portable u  connect the cord to and charging box so that's cook I can store it away easy but only this is it only gives u 60 sec it drys so slow I have to keep starting it over at least 10 times but I kinda get what i pay so for the price it's good and the packaging was good

I honestly love this product for the price. Just as a tip you will need to cure your thumbs separate. The way you lay your hands under the lamp doesn’t allow the bottom part of the thumbs to cure because there are no LEDs on the sides like a dome type design. Still tho, great value.

Good product. My nails (UV gel) were dry. I like that timer on the top. It has two selections, 30 and 60 seconds, and shows the timer counting down. Only negative was the legs don't lock in place. The slightest nudge and it falls on your hand.

I purchased this to replace my old one. I love how easy it is to store, it doesn't take up much space. Most importantly this gets the job done, I really like how this has a small display showing you the timer. This was money well spent.

The product is genius. The idea to have a foldable UV lamp is what a girl dreamed of. I can take it when I do mini spa parties and not have to worry about it taking up space. It’s sleek and very cute. Love it!

Could not believe this little lamp works. Have used it so far to cure a topcoat for a half assed gel manicure I got at the local salon. I plan on saving my money and doing my own nails at home from now on.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the lamp as lightweight, compact, and portable, making it easy to store or travel with.
Many customers consider it excellent value for the price and would recommend or gift it.
Several reviewers report it is easy to use and works well for curing polish, though some note it can require multiple cycles or longer cure times.
A recurring complaint is that the side panels or legs do not lock/snap into place, described as a minor design flaw.
Some reviewers experienced durability or power problems, including the lamp failing or the cord connection breaking.
